authorization.authorization_context: The owner instructed 'register it' for the prepared ln(3) flat-loss neural diagnostic (LN3_DIAGNOSTIC.md). The registered job measures per-record scores/spread, option geometry, and the same-example alternative-target gradient test on BOTH prompt-framing arms; it takes NO optimizer step and fails closed if any weight changed. Bound decision rules (from LN3_DIAGNOSTIC.md): (1) equal scores with distinct option vectors -> the fixed readout/projection loses the distinction; (2) near-parallel option vectors -> projection/pooling erases distinctions before the readout; (3) differing per-target losses with ~0 gradient norms -> the corrective signal does not reach the module; (4) usefully different gradient norms -> the machinery can express a preference and the flat pilot points to the allowance or optimization dynamics. The result is a measurement; no learning or capability claim follows from it alone.

execution_gates: single launch attempt through the diagnostic launcher; bounded readiness checks; verified cleanup on every exit
one new budget reservation exactly once through the canonical budget helper; no refund; no automatic retry
measurement only: no optimizer step anywhere; worker records checkpoint identity before and after each arm and fails closed if any weight changed
the accepted model, graph lessons, scoring, protected evaluation boundaries, and frozen negatives (0/72) stay untouched; sealed splits are not consulted
original errors and any completed progress preserved on any failure; evidence persisted on every exit
explicitly_not_authorized: any larger training run or additional experiment beyond this single measurement job
any optimizer step or weight update in the diagnostic worker
automatic retry of this or any prior job
any modification of accepted models, trainers, the ledger (beyond this job's reservation), frozen negatives, or sealed splits
any learning or capability claim from this diagnostic's measurements alone
